findings: Uninstall accepted forged manifests and unknown versions as ownership; fixed with separate per-version digests and complete preflight.
Unknown directory link could cause program deletion before failing with active pointer retained; fixed by preserving unknown trees and deactivating before deletion.
Data-only lease and interrupted receipt disagreement did not protect launch/uninstall; unified common validated dual-lease path.
Migrated valid copy could change BookId or rewind revision; now blocked while original backups remain.
Schema-v1 trigger/view could survive restore and alter later writes; read-only schema gate now precedes any store write probe.
Valid read-only backup could be copied before an avoidable failure; restore preflights source and reads through a consistent fresh SQLite inspection copy.
Read-only backup directory was unnecessarily required writable; scratch now has a separate writable data-root area.
remainingIntegration: Desktop OnStartup wrappers must call public LedgerFilePolicy.Validate before direct Storage Open/RestoreBackup, in addition to data-root and inventory controls.
platformBoundary: Linux static symlinks, read-only permissions and cooperating-process leases verified. Windows native installer/NTFS/ACL, hard-link identities, concurrent same-user directory swaps and real power loss unverified.
